steps.clueRiddle:
Your race begins on the softest seat in the house.
Rip this envelope open — that is how clues work!
steps.clueReveal: Sit in the living room with your team. Every clue works just like this one. Answer three warm-up questions about the trip.

challenges.title: Warm-Up Round
challenges.instructions: Tap the answer you think is right. Three questions only. Guessing is allowed — this one is practice.

trivia.q: Which city on our trip has a hotel that looks like a castle?
trivia.funFact: The Château Frontenac sits high on a cliff above the river.

trivia.q: Which animal will we see at the Montréal Biodôme?
trivia.funFact: The Biodôme keeps five whole ecosystems inside one building.

trivia.q: How do you say "hello" in French?
trivia.funFact: Bonjour really means "good day" — say it to everyone.

steps.funFact: Real Amazing Race clues come in yellow-and-red envelopes, just like yours.

steps.clueRiddle:
Head out the back door to your training ground.
Small things and green things are waiting to be found.
steps.clueReveal: Go outside to the backyard. Find all five things on the list. Tap each one to check it off.

challenges.title: Explorer Training
challenges.instructions: Find each thing on the list. Tap it to check it off. Take your time and look low.
checklist: A rock smaller than your thumb

steps.funFact: Racers call this a scavenger hunt — you will do lots of these.

steps.clueRiddle:
Two fast laps and one ticking clock.
Can you beat sixty seconds without a stop?
steps.clueReveal: Run twice around the house or the yard. Start the stopwatch first. Try to finish under 60 seconds.

challenges.title: Double Lap Dash
challenges.instructions: Tap start, then run two full laps. Stop the clock when you finish. Beat 60 seconds to win it.

steps.funFact: The little camera button is always optional — photos are just for fun.

steps.clueRiddle:
Pretend the couch is the back seat of the car.
Road games make the long drives fly far.
steps.clueReveal: Sit on the couch like it is the car. Play the practice bingo card. Then try a quick trivia round.

challenges.title: Backyard Road Bingo
challenges.instructions: Tap a square when you spot that thing. Four in a row is a bingo. This card works inside the house.

challenges.title: Trivia Test Drive
challenges.instructions: Five easy questions about our trip. Tap the answer card you like. Learn a fun fact after each one.

steps.funFact: On real driving days you will unlock a new bingo card each leg.

steps.clueRiddle:
Your very first mat is right here at home.
Meet your rivals — then the real race begins.
steps.clueReveal: Step onto the mat at home. The host will welcome your team. Then meet the four teams racing against you.
steps.funFact: Practice points do not count — the real season starts on August 2.
